items.title: Discovery
items.body: You tell me what is holding you back and I tell you whether automating it makes sense. If it doesn't, I'll tell you that too.

items.title: Proposal and scope
items.body: What gets done, what stays out, how much it costs and how long it takes. In writing, before we start.

items.title: Iterative development
items.body: Each stage is delivered, tested with your data and invoiced. No surprises at the end.

items.title: Deployment and support
items.body: I put it into production and look after it. When you want to tackle the next process, we start from here.
